Definition: Ziph, the name of a place in Palestine; also of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Ziph = "battlement"; n pr m; 1) a son of Jehaleleel, a descendant of Judah, and brother of Ziphah; n pr loc; 2) a city in southern Judah, between Ithnan and Telem; site unknown; 3) a city of Judah, southeast of Hebron, between Carmel and Juttah in the highland district
